info.title: API.SH: TrustRadius
info.description: The TrustRadius API from API.SH: public TrustRadius data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits
get.description: Credits by bucket (free monthly, plan, pay-as-you-go), the plan, credits spent today and this month (UTC), your spend limits and the key used. Free: costs no credits.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Usage per day and per endpoint
get.description: Calls, errors and credits per UTC day, and the top endpoints by credits. Free. Add output=csv for the daily rows as CSV.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key id.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO time.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Cursor from `next`.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
The products TrustRadius lists as competitors of a product, in its order: name, slug, link, TrustRadius score (out of 10), ratings count and a link to the head-to-head comparison page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trustradius-alternatives

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Product slug or a trustradius.com/products/<slug> link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A TrustRadius software category with its ranked products, 25 per page (the first 1,000 of a category): rank, name, slug, URL, vendor, description, TrustRadius score (out of 10), ratings and reviews counts, Top Rated flag and awards, starting price, free trial, pros and cons and feature ratings. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trustradius-category

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Category slug (trustradius.com/categories/<slug>) or URL.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-40).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A product on TrustRadius: name, vendor, category, description, TrustRadius score (out of 10) and ratings count, total reviews, star distribution, reviewer company sizes, roles, countries and departments, feature ratings, the community insights summary with pros and cons, and the three latest reviews. With `include=overview` it adds `pricing` (starting price and terms, editions with price and terms, pricing link), `integrations`, `features` (name, score, ratings count, category average, description), `competitors` (name, slug, score, ratings count), `awards`, `operating_systems`, `customer_verified` and `faq`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trustradius-product

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Product slug (trustradius.com/products/<slug>) or URL.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `overview` adds pricing, integrations, feature scores, competitors, awards and FAQ (adds to the cost of the call).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Reviews of a product on TrustRadius, 10 per page: title, rating (out of 10), date, trusted/incentivized/source flags, reviewer (name, title, company, size, industry, experience), pros, cons and every answered question (use cases, likelihood to recommend, ...). Sort and filter by star rating, reviewer company size, role, job type, department, industry, country, years of experience and last update; `filters` echoes the filters used and `total` counts the matching reviews. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trustradius-reviews

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Product slug or URL.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: newest, oldest, highest or lowest (default: the site's order).

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Star rating(s), comma-separated, 1-5: 5 = scores 9-10, 4 = 7-8, 3 = 5-6, 2 = 3-4, 1 = 1-2.

parameters.name: company_size
parameters.description: Reviewer company size(s), comma-separated: small (1-50 employees), medium (51-1,000), large (1,001+).

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Reviewer role(s), comma-separated: user, support, manager, decisionMaker, consultant, implementer.

parameters.name: job_type
parameters.description: Reviewer job type(s), comma-separated, e.g. Employee, Manager, Engineer, Director, Analyst.

parameters.name: department
parameters.description: Reviewer department(s), comma-separated, as in the product's `departments` (e.g. Marketing, Sales).

parameters.name: industry
parameters.description: Industry code(s), comma-separated (numeric).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Reviewer country code(s), 3-letter ISO, comma-separated, e.g. USA, GBR, IND.

parameters.name: min_years_experience
parameters.description: Reviewers with at least this many years using the product (1-4).

parameters.name: last_updated
parameters.description: Reviews updated within: month, 3months, 6months or year.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
TrustRadius products matching a search: name, slug, URL, logo, star rating (out of 5), ratings and reviews counts, Top Rated and customer-verified flags, category, a text snippet and the vendor link, 25 per page. Sort by relevance, number of reviews, highest rated, lowest rated or name. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trustradius-search

parameters.name: sort

parameters.name: page

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
